hover-tint.$description: The ground of whatever the pointer is over, in the accent's hue (rule 21). A button, a row, a menu entry and a tile all take this one colour, so two things lit side by side never differ. It keeps the OKLab lightness of surface3, which lifts a row off the card and a quiet button off surface2 while the text and the secondary text on it keep 4.5:1. On the dark ramps it sits 0.007 below surface3, where a saturated green would otherwise take the secondary text under 4.5:1. The chroma is a share of the accent's own, so a grey accent leaves surface3's grey. Declared again inside a rainbow position, so the hover takes the position's hue there, and in reactive mode only once the position lights up.

modes.name: oled
modes.$description: OLED moves surface3 one Carbon step down, and the hover with it.

hover-chroma.$description: How much of the accent's chroma the hover takes.

org.glimstone.tailwindNote: The accent's hover (rule 21): hover:bg-hover on anything the pointer can reach, a button, a row, a menu entry or a tile.
